summary: Log cabin lookout built 1930 in the Nez Perce-Clearwater forests, replaced by a 41-foot L-4 tower in 1956, abandoned 1971 and taken down by the mid-1980s.

facts.status_note: Taken down and burned in the 1980s; sources give 1984, 1986 or 1987. No source describes what remains today

corrections.proposed: 1930 built (two-story log cabin with cupola); 1956 replaced (L-4 cab on a 41-foot tower)
corrections.why: 1956 is when the L-4 tower went up. Four sources and the Forest Service post say the first lookout on the site was a log cabin with a cupola built in 1930, which the old record leaves out.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives the 1956 L-4 on a 30-foot tower; firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, Rex's and the Forest Service post give 41 feet. The record uses 41 feet (12.5 m); the story reports both.

The register and Rex's give 1986; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say gone by or confirmed gone in 1987; the Forest Service post gives 1981, 1984 or 1987 for the burning and an oral history gives 1984. No single date is firm, so the story reports the range.
Four sites date abandonment to 1971, but the Forest Service post says the tower was staffed for around 20 years after 1956. The story reports both.
The register gives 5,263 ft (1,604 m) and Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 5,259 ft. The record's 1604.2 m is kept; the difference is small and not in the story.

notes_for_editor: The 1956 'built' event in the brief is really the replacement tower; the first lookout dates to 1930 per four sources. The height of 41 feet (12.5 m) follows the majority; the register's 30 feet is recorded in the story. The Forest Service post is a Facebook repost of a Forest Service history; part one (the 1930 story) was not fetched. The Facebook post's oral history dates the removal to 1984 and the post itself does not settle the date. The brief's registration event (2022) was not verified in the fetched page, so it is not added. Photo credits (Fire Lookout Museum; Nez Perce-Clearwater archives) come without image URLs, so none added.
